profile.summary: SRKK AI Berhad, an investment holding company, through its subsidiaries, provides AI-enabled and digital transformation solutions in Malaysia, Singapore, and internationally. It provides information technology (IT) consultation and project implementation services for IT advisory and consulting, cybersecurity, business workflow automation, and networking solutions; IT managed services, including maintenance and technical support, and managed network and cybersecurity services; and cloud services. The company also offers data analytics and business intelligence solutions; and rents and sells IT hardware and software products. In addition, the company provides business process lifecycle services, low code app development, esignature solutions, robotic process automation, data, analytics & ai services, data consultancy and data implementation, analytics managed services, security solutions including microsoft security consultancy, security assessments and bcdr, business applications, it service management, remote monitoring & management, modern work automation, modern work security and modern work solutions, microsoft 365 managed services, microsoft copilot, sharepoint audit consultancy, enterprise cms (content ai), employee experience solutions, enterprise & client solutions, modern meeting room solutions, proactive device monitoring service, hardware solutions including servers and storage, azure infrastructure and microsoft azure infra solutions, microsoft azure managed services and microsoft azure infra assessments, customer engagement services including microsoft dynamics 365, as well as ai & automation academy offerings and training programs and schedules. It serves corporations, government-linked corporations, solution providers, and resellers and/or IT managed service providers. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Klang, Malaysia. SRKK AI Berhad operates as a subsidiary of Joel Resources Sdn Bhd.
